messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

On volume: we plan 4580 pcs per year, and we offer a 24- or 36-month commitment. This gives your plant stable, longer-term loading. The attached term sheets set out both options.

What is your earliest lead time for the first call-offs?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 frequency converter 7.5 kW
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We acknowledge your verified forecast increase and appreciate the proposed 24-month commitment, which supports our production planning. Regarding your inquiry, our earliest lead time for the first call-offs is six weeks. Reflecting the extended contract duration and maintaining the 30-day payment terms, we propose a revised price of EUR 427.96 per unit.

Specifically, our current Angebot comprises a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - part:350020: revised packages on payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming six weeks for the first call-offs. We respect the freeze on price reductions you described. As your sales director was open on payment terms, our revised packages now differ mainly there.

All three packages keep 4580 pcs per year over 24 months, which gives your plant two years of steady loading. One package carries 90 days payment, which matches our current agreement ctr:4600070530. The others carry 60 or 30 days. Each package moves toward your offer and lets you choose the cash profile that suits you best.

Which of these packages can you confirm as your standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - part:350020: revised packages on payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current offer stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

We appreciate your flexibility regarding payment terms and are prepared to accommodate the requested 60-day payment period. As previously communicated, our management has frozen price reductions, meaning that extended payment terms necessitate a corresponding adjustment to the unit price. We therefore propose a price of EUR 429.42 per unit for the 60-day payment option over a 24-month contract.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Frame agreement part:350020 - revised package, 90 days, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for your flexibility on payment terms. We have taken a further step towards your position on the package you lead with.

The attached term sheet keeps your structure: 90 days payment, as in our current agreement ctr:4600070530, 4580 pcs per year and a 24-month commitment. This gives your plant two years of steady, predictable loading. The volume and contract length match your own standing offer, so there is no extra planning effort.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement part:350020 - revised package, 90 days, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised proposal and the alignment on a 24-month contract for 4580 pieces per year. 

As previously communicated, our management has implemented a strict freeze on price reductions until December 2027. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Consequently, our terms remain a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.body: Thank you - we are very close. We can sign today on your own terms at the price in the attached term sheet.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We appreciate your readiness to conclude the agreement today based on the 90-day payment term and 24-month contract. However, as previously communicated, our management has strictly frozen all price reductions until December 2027. Therefore, we cannot accept your proposed price and must maintain our offer of EUR 430.88 per unit for this package.

Our offer stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
